summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_3 fix. Primary OOS-sidekick regression is fixed: 'Who won the FIFA World Cup?' and 'What is the capital of France?' both render sidekick-badge ('Suggested by AI (Outside Lecture Scope)') with a real general-knowledge answer, NO lecture bullets leaked. Pipeline B's SIDEKICK_KEY still 403s (console: '[LectureLens] Sidekick key failed (HTTP 403), trying next…'), but the new fallback chain (SIDEKICK -> RAG -> RAG_BACKUP) succeeds and OOS decision is preserved. All 5 scenarios pass 5/5.
action_items: (Non-blocking) VITE_GEMINI_SIDEKICK_KEY still returns HTTP 403 for gemini-3.6-flash. Fallback masks it, but the dedicated key is effectively dead — consider replacing so the sidekick badge in status footer accurately reflects a working key.
critical_code_review_comments: src/services/gemini.js: sidekickOrCleanOOS + whole-word offlineSearch + AbortController(25s) all landed correctly; OOS decision from Pipeline A is now honored on fallback so lecture text never leaks.
The status-footer 'Sidekick live' pill is optimistic — it is green even though the SIDEKICK key returns 403 on every call. Consider probing the key on boot and reflecting real status.
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage cleared at start of run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on desktop 1920x800 against live Gemini. Correct testids: search-input (not chat-input), send-btn, export-btn (not export-notes-btn), sidebar-toggle, sidebar (width 272<->72), lecture-switcher/lecture-option-<id>, active-lecture-chip, new-chat-btn, sidekick-message/sidekick-badge, ai-message/grounded-badge/offline-badge, citation-<hhmm>, evidence-frame/quote/speaker. IMPORTANT for future scripts: multiple badges accumulate across turns in same chat — use badge-count-delta or start a New Chat between assertions rather than locator.last. Timings: grounded RAG ~6-8s; sidekick fallback (after 403) ~7-12s; 40s wait is safe.
rca of the issue: PRIOR failure RCA (now resolved): (1) SIDEKICK_KEY 403 on gemini-3.6-flash caused Pipeline B first-attempt to fail — fix added an ordered key fallback [SIDEKICK, RAG, RAG_BACKUP] in runSidekick, and one of the RAG keys serves the sidekick call successfully. (2) offlineSearch used substring includes() and matched 'won' inside 'wondered', 'world' inside 'real world' — fix switched to \b whole-word regex and requires >=2 distinct hits (1 for single-word queries). (3) OOS decision from Pipeline A was being overwritten by fallback offline score — fix passes original OOS flag into sidekickOrCleanOOS so a clean OOS message renders if all live calls fail. Verified: FIFA + France questions both now return sidekick-message with sidekick-badge and general-knowledge text; no wavy-window/reflection/garlic terms present.
